basis: Recurrent hemarthroses directly destroy joints; the causative hemophilia is a separate coagulation disorder.

decisions.haematologic: none: this concept is the joint manifestation; the underlying hemophilia is a separately diagnosed coagulation disorder.

basis: Localized keratotic epithelial lesion of glans/preputial skin; genital location does not exclude a cutaneous lesion. Infection is only a risk factor.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: leukoplakia affects the surface epithelium of the glans or prepuce, rather than reproductive function.

basis: Defined by fatty degeneration of paraspinal muscles. Frequent neurologic annotations mix secondary etiologies and do not establish neural injury caused by idiopathic myopathy.

decisions.neurologic: none: HPO lists neural findings at 30-79%, but these reflect heterogeneous secondary causes; direct neural damage from the defined idiopathic muscle disease is not established.

basis: Calcium/PTH disorder; intrinsic nephrocalcinosis and hair/nail abnormalities each reported at 30-79%. Hypocalcemic arrhythmia does not establish intrinsic cardiac injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: arrhythmia is reported at 30-79%, but reflects hypocalcemic electrical disturbance; persistent cardiac injury is not established.
decisions.renal: involved: intrinsic renal calcium wasting causes nephrocalcinosis (HPO 30-79%); treatment can aggravate it but is not required.

basis: Pathological retinal neovascularization defines this eye disease; underlying diabetes is a separate diagnosis.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: diabetes causes this retinal complication but is a separately diagnosed metabolic disease; this concept establishes retinal damage.

basis: MRI establishes structural brain infarction despite absent clinical deficits; a specific vessel lesion is not established.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the demonstrated lesion is infarcted brain tissue; arterial thrombosis or another intrinsic vascular lesion is not specified.

basis: Complement-mediated hemolysis, thrombocytopenia and renal injury define aHUS; microvascular endothelial injury and thrombosis are defining, essentially universal.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: direct complement-mediated endothelial injury and microvascular thrombosis define the disease and occur in essentially all affected patients.

basis: Presynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder; muscle atrophy and arthrogryposis occur in 30-79%. Ptosis and ophthalmoplegia reflect neuromuscular dysfunction, not intrinsic eye injury.

decisions.ocular: none: ptosis (80-99%) and ophthalmoplegia (30-79%) arise from impaired neuromuscular transmission; direct damage to ocular tissues is not established.

basis: Erythrocytosis supplies the defining blood axis; pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma susceptibility does not establish endocrine organ disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: the definition specifies predisposition to endocrine tumors, not an existing endocrine tumor or gland dysfunction.

basis: Vertebral and tracheoesophageal defects predominate (fistula 6/12); developmental delay 3/9. Defining renal defects (2/9) and cardiac defects (2/11) omitted under the four-axis cap.

decisions.renal: none under cap: renal agenesis is defining but reported in 2/9; retain the more frequent developmental impairment (3/9) after skeletal and tracheoesophageal defects.
decisions.neurologic: involved: global developmental delay occurs in 3/9 (33%), meeting the frequency threshold for direct neurodevelopmental dysfunction.
